overview_description.description: Proprio Robotics develops autonomous robotic systems for data center operations. Its robots perform tasks across the server hardware lifecycle, including server assembly, rack deployment, component maintenance, upgrades, and equipment removal. Demonstrated functions include fan insertion, RAM extraction, switch recabling, GPU cabling, disk hot-swapping, and heatsink removal. The company combines physical AI models with robotic hardware for use in server rooms and other data center environments.
